item.tib: yang snying gsang ba'i thugs sgrub las bdud 'dul gsang ba'i sgrub pa
item.coloph: ces pas stag la phur sham can gyi dregs pa bdud 'dul gsang ba'i sgrub pa 'di ni dran pa nam mkha'i thugs dam bI tsa nas bka' gter dmar po ri yi gsang mchog gi pho brang gi (du) gter du sbas pas/ phyis su 'gro 'dul bstan gnyis gsang sngags gling pas zab gter rin po che spyan drangs shing / skal ldan brag steng sras yum dang / gter grogs dbang mo/ mchog sprul yid bzhin/ dar rgyas gling dang / khyung dgon bla ma sogs kyi dad sbyin gyis bskul ngor / rin chen zangs kyi brda' ris la/ brag steng dgon gyi nang so gzim chung du dag par phab pa'o/ yi ge ris byed mchog sprul g.yung drung bstan 'dzin gyis bgyis pas gshen bstan phyogs brgyar rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
